description: Source file implementing attention mechanisms and SDP backend selection for XPU, including functions for checking attention parameters, selecting backends, and performing fused attention operations.

methods.name: check_head_dim_size_xpu
methods.description: Checks if query, key, and value tensors have compatible head dimensions for XPU attention.

methods.name: check_no_grad
methods.description: Checks if any input tensors require gradient and if grad mode is enabled.

methods.name: can_use_overrideable_attention
methods.description: Determines if overrideable attention can be used based on tensor properties and constraints.

methods.name: can_use_cudnn_attention
methods.description: Indicates that cuDNN attention backend is not supported on XPU.

methods.name: minimum_gemm_alignment
methods.description: Calculates minimum GEMM alignment based on tensor data types.

methods.name: check_head_dim_size_mem_efficient
methods.description: Checks if tensors meet criteria for memory-efficient attention.

methods.name: can_use_mem_efficient_attention
methods.description: Determines if memory-efficient attention can be used based on tensor properties.

methods.name: priority_order
methods.description: Initializes and returns the priority order of SDP backends based on global context.

methods.name: select_sdp_backend_xpu
methods.description: Selects the appropriate SDP backend for XPU based on availability and constraints.

methods.name: _fused_sdp_choice_xpu
methods.description: Chooses the SDP backend for scaled dot-product attention on XPU.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_fused_attention_overrideable_xpu
methods.description: Performs fused scaled dot-product attention with overrideable backend on XPU.
